journeyMatrix._extend: Grow dimensions through auto-layout only: the matrix is a vertical stack of horizontal rows, cells set to FILL. Add a phase = add a column entry and let the row reflow; add a swimlane = add a row. Never absolute-position cells (collision-prone).

rules: Headlines are Poppins Bold UPPERCASE; body is Josefin Sans; labels are Poppins Bold uppercase small; tables, data and meta are Nunito (the template's table face); Questrial is embedded in the template but used once and is not a role.
No left rail, no dot-mark, no takeaway band color: dark surfaces are pure black with white text.
Body slides sit on white paper with ONE corner line-art background from bodyBackgrounds, rotated per slide so consecutive slides differ; keep text clear of the art corners.
Section dividers rotate through dividerFills (cyan with black text; purple, pink, orange with white text).
Sub-brand photo backgrounds are used only when the slide is about that sub-brand (The Ordinary, NIOD, Hylamide).
art._zones_note: zones = measured occupancy rectangles of each background in 1920x1080 stage space (cells with >1.5% non-white pixels on a 12x8 grid, merged). Text boxes must not intersect a zone; everything outside is free, so most backgrounds allow full-width text above y~540-675.
